Container.Name: Investigatarr
Container.Overview: Read-only security audit of your Unraid server. Checks management access, users, shares, Docker containers, VMs and listening services, then gives a score out of 100 with a fix for every finding.

Config.Name: Host root (read-only)
Config.Description: Host filesystem, mounted read-only so the scanner can read config. Do not make this writable.

Config.Name: Reports
Config.Description: Where report.json and index.html are written.

Config.Name: Scan interval (hours)
Config.Description: Rescan every N hours. 0 runs once and exits.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the report page is served on.
